title: Public groups are shared with everyone, personal groups only with the owner
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner/Admin user.
  • The Notifications page is open on the Tag groups tab.
  • An active location is selected.
  • A public group and your personal group.
  • A personal group owned by another user.
  • "Another user at the location" in the steps is Tech ShopView.
custom_steps:
1. As another user at the location, confirm the public group is visible and taggable.
  2. Confirm your personal group is visible/taggable only by you.
  3. Confirm another user's personal group is never listed and cannot be tagged.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A public group is visible to, and taggable by, every user at its location; a personal group is visible to, and taggable by, its owner only.
  • Another user's personal group is never listed and can never be tagged.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10249 (S6, Manage tag groups); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S6; design boards TagGroups/Modal; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-R22: “A public group is visible to, and taggable by, every user at its location.”
  • S6-R23: “A personal group is visible to, and taggable by, its owner only.”
  • S6-N4: “Another user's personal group is never listed and can never be tagged.”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
